items.title: Turn Freedom UI web pages into mobile pages with clio
items.body: An AI agent connected to clio version 8.1.0.137 turns a Freedom UI web page into a mobile page with its fields, data bindings and captions.

media.alt: A Documents record page in Creatio on the left and the same page converted to a mobile page on the right

items.title: See clio and Creatio developer news in Clio Satellite
items.body: Clio Satellite 2.7 shows news about clio and Creatio developer tools on the login page and in the app. Turn it on in extension options.

media.alt: Clio satellite menu in Creatio with the What's new row and the news panel open next to it
